components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Decisive midnight action on a light field.

components.name: Product Tray
components.description: High-key optical field for a catalog product.
components.css: .ds-product-tray{width:280px;color:#071a28;font-family:Assistant,sans-serif}.ds-product-art{aspect-ratio:1;background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 42%,#fff 0 28%,transparent 66%),#f7f7f3;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(7,26,40,.07)}.ds-product-tray h3{margin:16px 0 0;font:500 20px 'Frank Ruhl Libre',serif}.ds-product-tray p{margin:6px 0 0;color:#253744}

components.name: Maison Navigation
components.description: Flat white navigation with centered brand and hairline states.
components.css: .ds-nav{height:64px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto 1fr;align-items:center;padding:0 24px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(7,26,40,.11);background:#fff;color:#071a28;font:500 13px Assistant,sans-serif}.ds-nav strong{font:400 24px 'Frank Ruhl Libre',serif;letter-spacing:.18em}.ds-nav a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}.ds-nav a:last-child{text-align:left}.ds-nav a:hover,.ds-nav a:focus-visible{text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:6px}

components.name: Brand Signature
components.description: Two gilt hairlines around one small diamond geometry.

components.name: Try-On Passage
components.description: The single midnight experiential field in the light commerce journey.
components.css: .ds-try-on{min-height:360px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:center;padding:48px;background:#071827;color:#fff}.ds-try-on h2{max-width:7ch;margin:0;font:400 56px/1 'Frank Ruhl Libre',serif}.ds-try-on button{margin-top:28px;padding:14px 30px;border:1px solid #b5924b;border-radius:0;background:transparent;color:#fff;font:600 14px Assistant,sans-serif}.ds-try-on button:hover,.ds-try-on button:focus-visible{background:#fff;color:#071827;outline:none}

narrative.overview: LIBI presents jewelry as if it were being examined on a jeweler's light table: bright, calm, exact and free of decorative chrome. Real photography carries the material richness. Midnight ink appears primarily in text, controls and one immersive virtual try-on passage.
keyCharacteristics: Diamond-white page fields with pearl-toned product trays.
Large Hebrew display typography paired with quiet utility text.
Flat, square-edged compositions with hairline separation.
One dark experiential counterpoint per long commerce surface.
Real jewelry and atelier photography, never simulated decorative material.

rules.name: The Light Majority Rule
rules.body: Near-white surfaces occupy the clear majority of every commerce page; midnight is rare enough to remain meaningful.

rules.name: The Hairline Gilt Rule
rules.body: Gold marks selection and craft at small scale. It never becomes a decorative background.

rules.name: The One Display Voice Rule
rules.body: Frank Ruhl Libre owns expressive hierarchy; utility copy stays in Assistant.

rules.name: The Flat Light-Table Rule
rules.body: A surface does not receive both a visible border and a resting shadow.

dos: Do give jewelry photography more area than interface chrome.
Do use white space, scale and reading order before adding containers.
Do reserve gilt for hairlines, selection and signature geometry.
Do verify the 390px mobile composition and desktop composition independently.
donts: Don't rebuild the storefront from equal beige cards with layered shadows.
Don't place consecutive full-width dark sections on a commerce page.
Don't add decorative kickers above headings or invented luxury copy.
Don't use gradients or texture to imitate jewelry, paper, stone or metal when a real image should carry the material.
